evidence: TiCl4 (Aldrich Chemicals, 99.9% purity) and H2O (Milli-Q dispenser) were used as precursors. TiO2 films were deposited onto the membranes by sequential pulsing of precursor couples at a substrate temperature of 120 uC in an F-120 viscous flow-type reactor (ASM, Microchemistry). The pulsing times used were 0.4 s/0.5 s/0.5 s/0.5 s for the reaction sequence TiCl4/purge/H2O/purge respectively.
